text: οἴμοι! ὁ κόραξ ἔρχεται. τὰ ζῷα φοβεῖται.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Korax swoops down from above with his wings spread wide, looking menacing and angry
Dinosaur drops his arms and looks up with wide, frightened eyes
Panda stops clapping and cowers backward with a scared expression
Koala takes a step back toward the house with her paws raised defensively
Glaux flutters nervously on her perch
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit falls to the ground forgotten
